params.name: Loop
params.desc: see chapter 4.9.

params.name: LWAKE
params.desc: if false all WAKE definitions will be ignored.

params.name: Wk_Type()
params.desc: specifies the type or method of a wake field calculation. Valid keywords are Monopole_Method_F, Dipole_Method_F and Taylor_Method_F for wake field and Monopole_Method_P and Dipole_Method_P for wake potential input types.

params.name: Wk_filename()
params.desc: specifies the name of a file containing tabulated wake field or potential coefficients.

params.name: Wk_testfile()
params.desc: specifies the name of a file for test output. Output is only written if a file name is defined. The 3 columns of the file refer to the longitudinal position in the bunch [m], the local current [A] and the resulting longitudinal wake potential [V/C]

params.name: Wk_screen()
params.desc: if true the phase space distribution will be saved right after the wake kick has been applied.

params.name: Wk_scaling
params.desc: scaling factor for wake kick.

params.name: Wk_x()
params.desc: transverse origin of a wake field in x.

params.name: Wk_y()
params.desc: transverse origin of a wake field in y.

params.name: Wk_z()
params.desc: longitudinal origin of a wake field in z.

params.name: Wk_ex()
params.desc: x-component of the longitudinal direction vector.

params.name: Wk_ey()
params.desc: y-component of the longitudinal direction vector.

params.name: Wk_ez()
params.desc: z-component of the lonogitudinal direction vector.

params.name: Wk_hx()
params.desc: x-component of the horizontal direction vector.

params.name: Wk_hy()
params.desc: y-component of the horizontal direction vector.

params.name: Wk_hz()
params.desc: z-component of the horizontal direction vector.

params.name: Wk_equi_grid()
params.desc: if 1.0 an equidistant grid is set up, if 0.0 a grid with equal charge per grid cell is employed. Values between 1.0 and 0.0 result in intermediate binning based on a linear combination of the two methods.

params.name: Wk_N_bin()
params.desc: number of bins.

params.name: Wk_ip_method()
params.desc: interpolation method: 0 = rectangular, 1 = triangular, 2 = Gaussian.

params.name: Wk_smooth()
params.desc: smoothing parameter for Gaussian interpolation.

params.name: Wk_sigma_min()
params.desc: minimal sigma for Gaussian interpolation

params.name: Wk_sub()
params.desc: sub binning parameter.
